rules.title: quote_item! produces a synthetic `package main` module
rules.statement: `quote_item! { item* }` constructs a synthetic AST module whose root is MODULE with NAME="main", empty PATH_PARTS, ITEMS = the deep-cloned quoted items, and SRC_LINE=1. The result is emitted as a serialized WritStatic blob carried by a `QuoteItemBlob` value.

rules.title: quote_item! inherits the metafn's import scope
rules.statement: The synthetic module inherits the enclosing metafn's wildcard `use` packages, plus a self-use of the metafn's own package (if non-empty), so that unqualified names inside the quoted items resolve through the metafn's `use`-list. Each inherited package becomes one USE node carrying the full dotted package name in NAME.
rules.divergence: Logos metaprogramming addition; controls hygiene/name resolution of quoted items.

rules.title: Source and destination placeholder counts must match
rules.statement: The number of antiquot placeholders discovered while scanning the source items must equal the number of placeholder slots rewritten in the cloned destination tree; a mismatch is a compile error.
rules.uncertainty: This is an internal consistency invariant; user-observable only as a diagnostic.

rules.title: quote_item! evaluates to a QuoteItemBlob value
rules.statement: `quote_item!` evaluates to a `QuoteItemBlob` struct value with fields { template_ptr, template_size, idents_blob, blobs_blob, cursors_blob }, where template_ptr/template_size address the serialized synthetic-module blob and the *_blob fields carry the packed antiquot substitution data (null when the corresponding placeholder kind has zero occurrences).

rules.title: `#name`/`#(expr)` Ident antiquots are packed as Ident pointers
rules.statement: Each scalar Ident antiquot site (`#name` shortcut or `#(expr)` yielding Ident) contributes one `*const Ident` to the idents blob, in DFS placeholder order; a `#(expr)` form binds the lowered expression to a fresh local whose address is taken. When there are no Ident sites, idents_blob is null.

rules.title: ExprBlob antiquots are packed by their .ptr field
rules.statement: Each `#(expr)` antiquot whose lowered expression has type ExprBlob contributes one `*const u8` (the ExprBlob's `ptr` field) to the blobs blob, in DFS placeholder order; the lowered ExprBlob is bound to a local that outlives the array. When there are no ExprBlob sites, blobs_blob is null.

rules.title: Cursor (`#(...)*`) antiquots carry a per-site nesting depth
rules.statement: Each repetition-cursor antiquot site contributes a `*const u8` (the address of a Vec cursor variable) plus a parallel per-site depth byte: depth 1 = Vec<Ident>, depth 2 = Vec<Vec<Ident>> (nested `#(...)*`). The element type is the neutral `*const u8`; pack reads each cursor according to its depth. When there are no cursor sites, cursors_blob is null.
